text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Biwa Hayahide
have
come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These first three are crucial for an
Umamusume.
As for how she's doing now
that the Arima Kinen
is over...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's work on identifying my current
problems,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Frankly, I need more experience. The
senior
racers showed amazing
resourcefulness during
races, and
considering how intuition is derived
from
experience...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Are you listening?
choice_data_list: （まだ理論を突き詰めていた！）

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just because our first three years are
over doesn't
mean there won't be any
more races!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't exactly call this my "winning
equation"
until I can win every single
race I enter, after all.
Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She folds her arms calmly and stares at
me. The
way she carries herself is
formidable indeed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh... That goes without saying!
choice_data_list: これからも勝ち続けよう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I are going over our
plans for
future training when someone
approaches us...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I just came to tell you one thing. Next
time, I'll
beat you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And what if I don't let you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll do it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mhm. I wouldn't expect anything less
from you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: See you on the track.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm looking forward to racing you
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The exchange between the two sisters is

awkward... but their smiles sure do look
alike.
